title: Aureline M5 support-note closure gate
description: Canonical per-domain support-note closure gate minted by the retirement-review-packet and support-note-closure-gate lane over the frozen M5 retired-state matrix. Blocks a retirement candidate from moving to Retired while its review packet is not yet complete, so a line or stable-facing surface can never be closed while migration outcome, support-note closure, or archival signoff is still missing or a recorded exception would be silently dropped. Records the gate scope a blocker sits in — the retirement review packet is incomplete (missing migration outcome, archival refs, or the approval record), an unclosed help / support / partner / procurement / incident surface still points at the candidate, or an outstanding exception would be silently dropped from the retirement decision — and binds the affected retirement-candidate reference, the affected review-packet reference, the candidate-versus-successor reference, and the active gate reason so support, help, and public-proof surfaces read the closure state directly rather than re-deriving readiness by hand. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a candidate's closure-blocking readiness gaps by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
